messages:
Iris: Starting a small PR to update the Quickstart hello-app. Goals: unify env var to REDWOOD_KEY, add PowerShell example, and simplify the 'deploy' checklist.

Jon: Good. Can we also remove the legacy extras install? It's tripping up new users.

Iris: Yep, removed that line in the draft. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1244 (WIP)

Pat: Paste the final JS/Node snippet so I can sanity-run it.

Iris: Node snippet:
```js
const { Client } = require('redwood')
const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const res = await client.generate('Hello from Redwood')
console.log(res.text)
```

Jon: Also add a one-line Docker run and a PowerShell env var example: `$env:REDWOOD_KEY = "sk-..."`.

Iris: Added both. CI flagged a long line in quickstart.md.

ci-bot: docs-lint failed — line-length quickstart.md:38

Pat: I'll push a wrap fix and run the formatter.

Pat: Fix pushed. Removed an outdated internal link too.

doc-bot: Preview: https://deploy-preview-1244--docs.redwood.com/quickstart-hello

Jon: Quick pass done. Suggest replacing 'push to prod' with 'deploy to prod' and add a verification curl step.

Iris: Incorporated and force-pushed. CI green. Merging now.

ci-bot: All checks passed — merged.

Iris: Merged and added a tiny migration note for teams still using REDWOOD_API_KEY. Closing thread. :tada:
